title: Friday Fish Fry
metaTitle: Friday Fish Fry — Amber Inn, Eau Claire
metaDescription: The Amber Inn's Friday fish fry at 840 E Madison St, Eau Claire. Day, time and price at Wisconsin's oldest tavern.

data.title: Fish Fry
data.description: Fridays at the Amber Inn. Ask at the bar for the day's fish. Time and price will be confirmed by the kitchen.
details: Walk in. No reservations, no platform, no fee.
The bar is open later than the kitchen; the fish fry runs while the kitchen does.

data.heading: Make it a Friday
data.subtitle: Ten taps, heavy on German imports, and draft root beer in an iced mug for the kids.
